title: StaffSuite
description: StaffSuite adds all necessary moderation tools for your server.
body:
![Staff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a1fb067b460e1c3f9c90642e2f3a4500d5bb75a.png)

StaffSuite is a plugin designed to help you moderate your server from exploiters. With StaffSuite you can spectate people without losing your previous location and items. While in spectator mode, you remain visible to yourself in the tab list, but other players cannot see you. (Intended feature)

Commands
   ↓
                
"/staff spectate <player>" To spectate the player

"/staff unvanish" To go in to protected creative where you cant break, place or get blocks and cant deal damage.

"/staff survival" Puts you back in survival and restores your items, latest position before you spectated and gamemode.

"/staff help" Show available commands.

"/staff respectate" Return to last player you spectated.

"/staff retp" Show the five recent players you've spectated.

"/staff retl" Show the five recent locations you've spectated/been.

"/staff goto <index> Teleport to a saved location from history.

"/staff inv <player>" View another player's inventory, you can also edit persons inv.

"/staff echest <player>" View another player's echest, you can also edit the persons echest.

"/staff gamemode spec" Switch to spectator mode while unvanished.

"/staffchat <Message>" To message other people with staff permission.

"/staffchat toggle" To toggle staffchat.

"/staffchat help" To show available staffchat commands.

"/sc <Message>" To message other people with staff permission.

"/sc toggle" To toggle staffchat.

"/sc help" To show available staffchat commands.
